A.notes: A has a coherent editorial-console idea and the strongest expression of the core promise: finding one decisive line in a sea of logs. Typography and layout feel considered, with good product mockups, but the motion evidence is only moderately clear from the scroll strip and the phone capture suggests some sections/components are not resolving as cleanly on mobile. Measured accessibility and reduced-motion support are strong.

B.notes: B presents a clear on-call, terminal-first concept and its scroll-strip sequence more clearly shows the product state progressing as you move down the page. The visual system is solid and readable, but the overall structure feels closer to a familiar dark SaaS template, and the full-page/mobile captures show large empty stretches that weaken confidence in responsive craft. Accessibility/performance checks are clean.

raw.why: A is the more distinctive and better-voiced design overall, even though B shows slightly stronger motion evidence.
